dct_title_s: Nebraska Groundwater Level Map (Decline & Rise), Fall 1963
dct_description_sm: Black and white map of Nebraska divided by counties. "Map of Nebraska showing as of the fall of 1963 areas where the water table has risen or declined 5 feet or more from the mean of the period of record."
